Haryana launches 'Digital Kavach' for cyber security

The state of Haryana has launched a new initiative named 'Digital Kavach' aimed at enhancing cyber security measures. This program is designed to bolster the state's defenses against cyber threats and protect digital infrastructure. The initiative signifies a proactive approach by the Haryana government to address the growing concerns around cyber security in the digital age.
